scene: You step from your wooden rowing boat onto a mossy station platform.
picture: Flat side view along a flooded tiled station platform line. On the left sits an empty wooden rowing boat tied to a post. Left of centre stands the dark-haired boy in glasses and denim jacket. Beside him on the far left stands a rusty glowing vending machine. Water lilies float centre, and tiled stairs rise far right.
shown: a rusty vending machine glowing faintly green on the far left platform
a huge pink water lily floating in the dark water at centre
an arched tiled stairway leading up into shadow on the far right

variants.scene: Cool tunnel water laps gently beside the mossy, silent tiled platform.
A glowing lotus drifts peacefully while you search for {quest}.
Damp air fills the underground canal where brick arches stretch into darkness.
